status: digital V7 M2 rear-interface correction candidate; physical coupon and complete head release remain required before production ASA printing

rear_structure.construction: six shell-integrated rear-normal M5 pad bosses on four complementary non-overlapping trusses; no pad is owned by the removable bezel or bottom keel
rear_structure.middle_pad_geometry: 21 mm circular boss; largest whole-mm diameter that clears the complete seated V0.5-M2 metal envelope on both frozen X +/-20 axes
rear_structure.nominal_fastener: M5x20 rear-loaded bolt and 10 mm OD rear washer into a shell-side captive M5 nyloc; press each nyloc into its hex pocket before the complete M2 module enters

serviceable_socket.construction: retain the frozen 21 mm square cavity, axis, depth, lead-in, and M4 station in a shell-integrated U-cradle; remove only the rail-outboard wall and restore it after rail seating with a keyed ASA cap
serviceable_socket.cap_m3_nominal: M3x10 button-head into short brass heat-set insert

acceptance_holds: The coordinated V0.5 bottom M5 centers are locked at X +/-7.4, V -30; V7 may not move any other plate hole, adapter hole, angle-base hole, rail axis, lower target, socket datum, or hardware station.

All six rear M5 pads must be true-unioned through broad trusses into their four owning body shells; the removable bezel, bottom keel, and eight cosmetic M3 seam screws may not carry this structural shell-to-plate attachment.
Opposing left/right pad and truss geometry must remain complementary and disjoint at the complete seated shell assembly.

Every M5 bolt, washer, and captive nyloc must be placeable without corner, angle, rail, shell, or neighboring-hardware interference. The 14 mm captive-nut insertion tool is validated before the M2 module enters; final fastening uses the rear 14 mm tool only.
The 21 mm straight socket cavity, 23 mm lead-in mouth, frozen axes, 30 mm depth, and existing M4 cross-bolt stations remain unchanged.

With both outer socket caps removed, the complete rigid M2 aluminum assembly must clear every fixed printed part along the densely sampled withdrawal and rear-clearance path; insertion is the exact reverse path. Crossbolt service relief may remove only new internal rear-truss material, never approved exterior shell skin.
With both caps installed, each rail must be enclosed by the restored 21 mm cavity and retained by the existing M4 path plus four accessible M3 cap screws.
No new truss, pad, cap receiver, or fastener feature may protrude through the approved exterior or obstruct a wrapped-panel landing surface.
Every production shell and socket cap must be one closed manifold printable component.
A support/brim-inclusive Prusa MK4 Generic ASA slice with at least 10 mm XY margin remains required before any full ASA print release.
Lamp, steering, ears, eyes, glow-panel mounts, final shell seams, and physical vibration validation remain separate production blockers.
